title: Drums on one side only

complaints.says: The drums are only coming out of the left speaker.

win.label: Drums equally loud left and right
win.hint: Select Ch 11 and turn Link 11+12 back on.

hints: The drums come in on a stereo pair of room mics, channels 11 and 12. Are both channels up?
cause: The Room L/R channels had been unlinked, and Room R's fader was down, so only the left room mic reached the mains.
lesson: Stereo pairs (room mics, keys L/R) should be linked so one fader moves both sides together.
